title: Motilal Oswal raises mid and smallcap allocation to 50%, stays neutral on Indian equities
summary: Motilal Oswal Private Wealth favors Indian mid and small-cap stocks. They are increasing allocations to these segments by ten percentage points. The firm suggests a neutral stance on Indian equities overall. Hybrid and large-cap allocations are set at forty percent. Global equities will comprise the remaining ten percent of investments.

title: US Fed leaves federal funds rate unchanged: How can a status quo impact the Indian stock market?
summary: The US Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged on 29 July. While the decision may ease foreign capital outflows and strengthen the rupee, looming inflation risks and geopolitical tensions remain significant concerns for investors.&nbsp;
